title: Terms and robots.txt that govern www.amazon.jobs and www.metacareers.com, read from the live pages
notLegalAdvice: A record of what the pages say, for the user's decision. It is not legal advice.
how: Fetched on GitHub-hosted runners by .github/workflows/freshness-probe.yml (read-only capture: honest User-Agent 'melon-seek/0.2 (+https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/; open-source job-postings salary chart; terms and robots.txt check)', one request per page, robots.txt and legal pages only, no job page, listing or search endpoint), decoded locally with node .github/scripts/freshness-probe.mjs --decode. The build sandbox and WebFetch cannot resolve these hosts. Earlier quotes in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md came from search results.

robots.reading: The rules allow job pages and list the jobs sitemap, but the file opens with a notice that automated collection needs express written permission. The notice's link redirects to the Automated Data Collection Terms (run 38136777427). docs/DATA_SOURCES.md 7g leaves the notice out.

quotes.1: These Automated Data Collection Terms (“Terms”) between you and Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta” or “we”) govern your Use of data collected from Meta Company Products through Automated Data Collection (“Collected Data”).
quotes.2: You will not engage in Automated Data Collection without first obtaining Meta’s express written permission or in any manner that is not explicitly authorized by Meta. The term of these Terms will begin on the date you accept them or otherwise engage in Automated Data Collection of Meta Company Products, and will continue until you certify to us that you have deleted and are no longer conducting Automated Data Collection or Using Collected Data, Meta revokes such permission, or these Terms are terminated as described below.
quotes.3: Meta’s express written permission to engage in the Automated Data Collection is subject to your agreement to abide by these Terms, which incorporate by reference the Meta Terms and Policies. For avoidance of doubt, acceptance of these Terms alone does not constitute the required written permission to conduct Automated Data Collection; such permission must be obtained separately through Meta’s formal authorization process. Notwithstanding any such permission that Meta has granted, Meta reserves the right to implement measures to restrict your Automated Data Collection and Use of Collected Data at any time for any reason.
quotes.4: The Collected Data shall only be Used for the purpose of (i) providing results for your Search Engine, or (ii) displaying previews of Meta URLs to your users, and (iii) for other purposes for which you have received Meta’s express written permission to Use Collected Data. All other Uses are prohibited, including, but not limited to, transferring, selling, licensing or sublicensing Collected Data and data derived from Collected Data to any third party, including your subsidiaries and affiliates.
quotes.robots: You will comply with Meta’s robots.txt protocols, page header tags, and similar opt-out protocols that we implement.
quotes.identify: You will only use IP addresses, user-agent strings, and other identifiers that identify your services.
quotes.definition: “Automated Data Collection,” for purposes of these Terms, refers to the collection of data from Meta Company Products via the use of automated or programmatic tools capable of navigating or indexing the surface-layer of the World Wide Web. These tools may include but are not limited to web scrapers, bots, robots, spiders, crawlers, user-agents, and other automated or programmatic mechanisms designed to access, collect, or retrieve data or content directly from web pages or applications.
quotes.products: “Meta Company Products” shall have the same definition as those applied in the Facebook Terms of Service
